S01.competitorCapability: Exact joins over one or multiple columns plus anti/full outer joins.
S01.notes: A stable-key join needs no entity-resolution workbench.

S02.competitorCapability: Repeatable transformations followed by a multi-column exact merge.
S02.notes: Case, whitespace, punctuation, and formatting can be normalized deterministically.

S03.competitorCapability: Fuzzy text merge with threshold, similarity score, transformation table, and multiple returned matches.
S03.notes: Power Query was not executed; the case is intentionally simple and documentary capability appears sufficient.

S04.competitorCapability: Fuzzy merge exposes an aggregate similarity score, but current documentation does not describe Samewise-style weighted per-field positive and contradictory evidence.
S04.notes: Samewise was executed and routed the contradiction to review; Power Query was not executed.

S05.competitorCapability: Configurable composite matching, column scores, match review, selected-for-later review, and manual Not Duplicate decisions.
S05.notes: DataMatch materially overlaps the claimed review value; alternative-ranking ergonomics were not executed.

S06.competitorCapability: RecordLink supports one-to-one and many-to-one constraints after scoring.
S06.notes: Samewise surfaces collision context but explicitly does not solve global assignment.

S07.competitorCapability: Master-record selection, field-level overwrite rules, golden-record creation, and export.
S07.notes: DataMatch is broader and at least conceptually stronger. Samewise also cannot apply survivorship to values mapped only as identity evidence.

S08.competitorCapability: Label-based precision/recall, prediction-error inspection, threshold selection, ROC, and model diagnostics.
S08.notes: Samewise adds frozen product snapshots and compatibility gates, but not greater statistical evaluation rigor.

S09.competitorCapability: Reusable projects, exported profiling, traceable configurable logic, scheduling, and export are documented; deterministic source/artifact hashes were not verified.
S09.notes: Samewise deterministic manifests are executed locally, but documentary absence is not proof of competitor absence.

S10.competitorCapability: Match results, groups/pairs, column scores, selection for later review, manual Not Duplicate, entity graphs, and match review are documented.
S10.notes: Samewise queue/keyboard/defer/undo/collision workflow is implemented; DataMatch throughput ergonomics were not executed, so no unique-workflow claim is justified.
